newsitem.title: GREECE: ALPHA CREDIT BANK KEEPS PRIME RATE AT 16.75PCT.
newsitem.headline: ALPHA CREDIT BANK KEEPS PRIME RATE AT 16.75PCT.

text.p: Greece's Alpha Credit Bank said its prime rate for working capital and fixed asset loans, recently cut by 50 basis points to 16.75 percent will stay unchanged this week.
Alpha Credit, which reviews its rates weekly, said the maximum add-on would remain unchanged at 3.5 percent.

Its adjustable-rate mortgages recently set lower will remain at 17.00 percent. The bank launched 15-year mortgages in October 1995 with rates set at 12.0 percent for the first five years. Rates on these loans have dropped to 11.75 percent. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
